title: Multilingual Resources for Migrant Workers NSW - Multilingual education program
content: Source PDF filename: rmwc_workplace_rights_vi.pdf; source PDF page: 1.
RMWC describes a multilingual education program that provides free translated resources and community education initiatives across New South Wales.
The program focuses on work health and safety, workplace rights and access to support services for migrant workers.
The document describes RMWC as a support and referral organisation, not a source of legislation or an enforcement agency.
Publication date is not stated in the PDF; access date is 13 September 2026.
